app.name: Business Watchdog
app.tagline: Monitoring for store sales and payments

common.error_generic: The data could not be loaded. Try again; if it keeps failing, send us the request ID.
common.error_network: The server cannot be reached. Check your internet connection.
common.error_forbidden: You don't have permission for this. Ask the account owner.
common.error_not_found: Not found. It may have been deleted or belong to another account.
common.error_conflict: This was changed in another window. We loaded the current version — check it and try again.
common.error_rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
common.selected: Text selected — copy it with Ctrl+C (⌘C).

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use the e-mail and password you registered with.
auth.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
auth.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
auth.session_expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

overview.title: Stores
overview.subtitle: What the service can currently see for each store. "No data" does not mean everything is fine.
overview.empty_body: Stores you add appear here with the state of the plugin, money reconciliation, payment attempts and checkout checks.

money.label: Money reconciliation
money.detail_provider: connect Stripe or PayPal to reconcile

create.title: New store
create.subtitle: Enter the store address. Then connect the plugin and confirm that you own the domain.

form.name: Name
form.base_url_hint: Public address starting with https://, without login, password or anchor (#).

invalid.name: Enter a name of up to 100 characters.
invalid.base_url: A public https:// address is required, without login, password, anchor or a non-standard port.
invalid.timezone: Choose a time zone from the list.

connector.title: Store plugin
connector.subtitle: The plugin sends orders, refunds and payment attempts. Without it the service cannot see what happens in the store.
connector.none: The plugin is not connected yet.
connector.revoke_warning: The plugin key will be revoked and store data will stop arriving. To connect again you will need a new code.
connector.code_once: The code is shown once and is valid for 15 minutes.
connector.step_install: Install and activate the Business Watchdog plugin in WordPress.
connector.step_paste: Paste the service URL and the connection code, then click “Connect”.
connector.waiting: Waiting for the plugin to connect — the list updates by itself.

verification.title: Domain confirmation
verification.subtitle: Confirms the store is yours. Checkout checks do not run until the domain is confirmed.
verification.plugin_hint: Easiest: the plugin publishes the confirmation code on your site by itself.
verification.dns_hint: Add a TXT record at your domain registrar or DNS provider.
verification.dns_help: Add a TXT record with these values to your domain DNS. DNS updates can take a few hours.
verification.plugin_help: The plugin receives the code with its next signal (within 5 minutes) and publishes it on your site. Nothing to do.

reason.dns_record_missing: The TXT record was not found yet. If you just added it, wait for DNS to update.
reason.challenge_mismatch: The site responds, but the code does not match. The plugin may not have received the new code yet.
reason.store_url_changed: The store address changed during the check. Start the confirmation again.
reason.connection_failed: Could not connect to the site.
reason.dns_failure: The domain could not be found in DNS.
reason.http_status_unexpected: The site returned an error. Check that the plugin is active.
reason.redirect_not_allowed: The site redirects to another address. Check the store address.
reason.response_too_large: The site returned an unexpectedly large response.
reason.unsafe_destination: The address points into a private network and cannot be checked.
reason.other: The check has not passed yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.currency_note: Changing the currency does not convert past amounts.
settings.pause_hint: Pausing stops scheduled checkout checks and the nightly reconciliation. Plugin data keeps arriving.
settings.resume_hint: Monitoring is paused: scheduled checks and the nightly reconciliation do not run.
